name: werkzeug-ef518e42-blind20-v1
instr:
# Werkzeug: hunting twenty regressions without a test suite

A program built on this library — the layer that sits between a web server and the code
that answers callers — now gets a long list of things wrong. Nothing about the protocol
changed and none of the calling code changed. The same traffic that used to be served
correctly now comes back wrong, and in several places what used to be a clean answer is
now an outright failure. The repository has received 20 separate undocumented edits. What
follows is everything I have been able to pin down by exercising the library; the problems
are unrelated to one another, so please do not assume one repair explains the rest.

Start with reading what a caller sent. Deciding which of several content types a caller is
willing to take is badly wrong throughout: the best candidate from a list comes back
wrong, or nothing comes back where a suitable candidate plainly exists; the supplied
fallback is handed over when a genuine fit was available and withheld when it was not; a
catch-all entry in the caller's list is treated backwards, so it no longer covers concrete
types; picking between a broad offer and a narrower one chooses wrongly; and asking a
parsed form of that same header for the weighting of one type gives wrong numbers.

Working out which site a caller addressed when it sent no header naming one — so it must
be rebuilt from the server's own name and port — no longer gives the expected answer, for
